result: Partial: float fast kernels for asinf, acosf, atanf, atan2f (one double atan reduction, Remez fit, proved bounds, rounding test, accurate fallback); other families not started
head: bc5b4bf6

rulings.item: hardware sqrt in liella-math (SSE2 intrinsic counts as unsafe there; crate forbids unsafe)
rulings.recommendation: keep software sqrt64 unless the after counts show it dominates asinf/acosf; then a safe sqrt helper from liella-rt with an UNSAFE(arch) site

rulings.item: split the brief per family (hyperbolic, erf, gamma, Bessel, sinf shrink): Size L does not fit 90 calls
rulings.recommendation: one story per family on this pattern

informational: before counts (instr Liella/glibc): asinf 1550.0/53.5, acosf 1555.7/61.2, atanf 1380.1/66.7, atan2f 1619.6/147.7, sinf 167.3/42.0
plants 4/4 CAUGHT (bound, coefficient, reduction-edge, table-entry); no Bessel zero-table plant: Bessel not implemented
atan2f has 2^64 operand pairs: the accuracy check is a 2^32-call wide sample, not exhaustive
cargo xtask bench --compare has no --rows; CBENCH_ROWS in the environment works (prefix match)
improvement: Brief sized L with 18 kernels and a 90-call budget: split code briefs to one kernel family each so a run can finish with gate, plants, counts and sweep.
next_step: Read the -after and -sweep logs on keke; then the hyperbolic family (sinhf..atanhf) on the same pattern.
